description: Deletes the link between an external user (from an integration provider like GitHub, Slack, GitLab, or MS Teams) and a Sentry user within the specified organization. This removes the association but does not delete the Sentry user itself. Requires org:admin or org:write permissions.

external_user_id.description: The unique numerical identifier of the external user linkage to delete. This ID is returned when creating an external user via the 'create_external_user_for_organization' action.
external_user_id.title: External User Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization from which to delete the external user link.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

name: delete_external_user_from_organization

DeleteExternalUserFromOrganizationRespon.description:
Response schema for `DeleteExternalUserFromOrganization`.

Returns 204 No Content on successful deletion with no response body.
DeleteExternalUserFromOrganizationRespon.title: DeleteExternalUserFromOrganizationResponse
